features: Corpus capture has an internal report output option independent of public reporter/outfile configuration. Ordinary public dots/JUnit and parallel public JUnit controls preserve internal evidence. Public and internal files use the same native case collection.

Changed-selection options use coordinated native execution. A tracked dependency change selects the affected test like direct native execution; a clean Git state runs no bodies and receives zero passing-case credit.
Native terminal metadata remains available for zero-case runs while public JUnit formatting remains pinned.
limitations: Broader reporter/empty-output/config combinations, watch-mode changed updates, Git edge cases, mixed roots, prepared plan/vendor/script-mode integration, worker lifecycle and all-platform behavior remain open in #876.
The nine selected original files retain #874: 62 passing cases, three process checks, one failure/failed file, 40 filtered cases and zero skips/TODOs. This is not a green full suite.

Stale-cache configuration failure, variable-shadow diagnostic and disk-admission refusals/cleanup are retained. Duplicate restored evidence copies were checked against committed archives before removal. Original logs/sources and active global/context producers remain preserved.

No original assertions or snapshots were modified. HTTPS receiver/lifecycle remain open in #875/#532. Excluded constructor/Deno regressions were not rerun. Full Bun suite, #872 and Release/ASAN/all-platform coverage remain open under #66.
